name: xxd-ui-kit
description: 小小东 UI Kit：中文优先、不依赖框架的界面组件，专门照顾 Chrome 插件（MV3）；React 版基于 Cloudflare Kumo（MIT）

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cloudflare/kumo build && pnpm xxd:build && pnpm --filter @xxd/site build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @cloudflare/kumo lint && vp lint packages/kumo-docs-astro/src packages/kumo-screenshot-worker/src packages/xxd-react/src packages/xxd-tokens packages/xxd-icons packages/xxd-css packages/xxd-extension packages/xxd-mini/src packages/xxd-mini/scripts packages/xxd-mini/taro-plugin packages/xxd-mini/test packages/xxd-mini-demo/src packages/xxd-mini-demo/scripts packages/xxd-site/src packages/xxd-site/scripts scripts
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist build .astro .wrangler node_modules
scripts.xxd:test: pnpm --filter "./packages/xxd-*" -r test && pnpm --filter @cloudflare/kumo exec vitest run src/xxd-contract.test.ts
